parsed.name: 旋转编码器
parsed.description: 用于检测车轮或旋转轴脉冲计数的传感器，可根据计数与时间间隔估算速度、行驶距离和里程，常用于移动机器人或小车实验中的运动反馈与里程计测量。
parsed.description_en: A sensor that counts pulses from a wheel or rotating shaft and uses tick counts over time to estimate speed, traveled distance, and odometry for motion feedback in mobile robot or small vehicle experiments.

actions.description: 循环更新编码器计数、时间间隔以及距离和里程估计。
actions.description_en: Continuously update encoder tick counts, time intervals, and distance/odometry estimates.

actions.description: 在线程模式下输出当前编码器测得的运动状态，用于与控制循环配合运行。
actions.description_en: Provide the current motion state measured by the encoder in threaded operation for use by a control loop.
